items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Aside from the bigger band, Sidney Desvinge's band... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Sidney had fifteen pieces.

ctx.x: No, I never didn't know where company made them. I never didn't know where we made them. But you could get them in the store. I don't know.

Did you ever play in any smaller bands? I know you say you worked in a lot of different bands and all too. Aside from the bigger band, Sidney Desvinge's band, how many pieces was it? About ten or twelve or something? Sidney's band?
Yeah. Sidney had fifteen pieces. Fifteen piece.
